info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Mahogany Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to submit detailed information about mahogany pendant products to the catalog. It is designed for businesses seeking to enhance their inventory with rich product descriptions and specifications. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and e-commerce platforms that aim to maintain accurate and comprehensive product listings. By utilizing this endpoint, users can ensure their mahogany pendant offerings are accurately represented, facilitating better customer engagement and sales opportunities.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for a mahogany pendant. By providing the necessary information in the request body, you can add specific characteristics and features associated with the mahogany pendant.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create or update a mahogany pendant. It includes all necessary fields to define the pendant's characteristics and specifications. Please ensure that the data conforms to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data returned.
